description: List all SLF snow measurement stations in Switzerland (IMIS automatic stations and manual study plots). Returns station code, name, altitude, canton, and type. Sorted by elevation descending.

canton.description: Filter by canton abbreviation (e.g. GR, VS, BE). Optional.

limit.description: Maximum number of stations to return (default: 20, max: 200).

type.description: Station type: "imis" (automatic) or "study-plot" (manual). Optional — returns both by default.

name: list_snow_stations
